title: Skills docs: a seed record in a keyed mode must carry every externalId field or it is refused at load (seeds.md)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaysxGzF62ACvZ1x9x

Filing gate: ② Skills-docs follow-up owed by PR #35459 (#34857 + #35336, ruling B1), L1-a R1 7007542258. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:skills` (`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`). Suggested-grade: p2 · same grade as the cards it follows. Same file as #35456 (fold candidate under the seat's rules; both add save/load rules to seeds.md).
Dedupe: `seeds.md externalId blank refused` in open issues: #35456 covers the unknown-object rule only.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用技能写初始化数据时，会被提醒每条记录都要填上唯一标识字段，否则这条记录加载时会被拒收。
- 为什么做：加载时拒收留空标识的记录已经上线（你选的方案 B1），技能文档还没写这条规矩。
- 出错会怎样：只是文档；不改的话，按技能写出的数据可能在加载时被拒收一部分记录。
- 要你做什么：无（分诊定级）。

## What happens

After PR #35459, in the keyed seed modes (`ignore`, `upsert`, `update`) the loader refuses a record whose externalId value is blank (no value, `null` or `''`) in any composite component or in the single key field (`name` by default), naming the object, record index, field and fix; other records load. `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` does not say so at :48 (the externalId row), :68 (composite keys) or :93 (externalId selection).

## Expected

seeds.md states the rule at those three anchors: a record in a keyed mode carries every externalId field (or the default `name`), whitespace counts as a value, and a blank one is refused at load. Optionally one eval in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` that authors a keyed seed with a blank key and expects the refusal. Land after PR #35459.
